claims.label: PROVED

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For p^s|q_n, the truncated valuations of the residual product and scalar-Casoratian product equal the truncated weighted sum of return depths at q_(n+h_i).

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: If total multiplicity is at most fixed K and the product reaches depth s with O(n) height, some gap O(n/log n) carries a return at level p^ceil(s/K).
claims.evidence: report Section 4; pigeonhole principle plus the exact gap budget
claims.scope_limit: the uniform existence or exclusion of that partial-depth return is open

claims.label: PROVED

claims.evidence: report Section 5; exact discrete balancing exchange
